content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Ann Patrick (E035)
Role: Engineer
Employment type: contractor
Requested: admin access to Source Code

Policy:
- Contractors: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.
- HR note: no advanced security training on record → maximum is read.
- Security note: basic security training → maximum is read.

Requested admin exceeds maximum read. Per policy, grant the maximum (read). Never grant more than requested - read is less than admin, so that's fine.

Decision: read.
